snippet.title: Penny the Pumpkin: Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🎃 Penny the Pumpkin: Director's Cut 🎃
Play FREE in your browser (desktop & mobile):
https://www.kaisalmon.itch.io/penny-the-pumpkin

Explore a charming open-world metroidbrainia filled with secrets, puzzles, and bouncy physics!
Guide Penny, the lovable squishable pumpkin, through an interconnected world as you collect 18 precious coins. Stretch, bounce, and discover subtle hidden mechanics that will change how you navigate this adorable PICO-8 adventure.

✨ FEATURES:
Adorable physics-based soft-body animations
Interconnected open world with 7 unique areas
18 coins to collect across diverse environments
Subtle hidden mechanics - "metroidbrainia" gameplay
Challenging speedrun mode (current dev record: 3:31.4)
Delightful soundtrack that changes between areas

Made with ♥ in under 32kb, for the PICO-8

#indiedev #pico8 #metroidbrainia #pixelart #gamedev #retrogaming
Music by @packbat
